purpose: Required future native zetesis acceptance target; not a passing test report.
selection: All original .lp files except named -clingcon theory sources and their explicitly including scenarios; filename, theory, and include evidence checked for every exclusion.

reference_execution_note: Reference commands are reproducible proposed comparison invocations, not claimed executed results. They retain full source and include resolution. optN output requires selecting final-optimal models and avoiding duplicate incumbent/optimal-phase witnesses.
